## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-juan Táng compilation of Fùdàshì's teachings and associated materials, X69 n1335. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted.

[Fùdàshì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%82%85%E5%A4%A7%E5%A3%AB) 傅大士 / Shànhuì 善慧 (497–569): Liáng-dynasty lay Buddhist; a visionary-eccentric figure who is traditionally regarded as an incarnation of Maitreya. Associated with the monastery Sōngshān 嵩山 and later Shuānglínshān 雙林山. Credited with the invention of the *lúnzàng* rotating-canon-library and with numerous miraculous and prophetic compositions.

Compiler [Lóu Yǐng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%A8%93%E9%A0%B4) 樓頴: Táng-era compiler; lifedates unrecorded. His editorial work assembled the Liáng-era Fùdàshì materials into canonical *yǔlù* form.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 780 (Táng compilation horizon); *notAfter* c. 830.
